notes.title: 1 Year Anivesraiy Update
notes.notes:
\[Game Update 32 – 1-Year Anniversary Update] 

\[New Features]

After accepting the invitation to Cat Planet, Gorge, the planet’s president, will introduce the current situation and your main goal in the game.

You can now compete with other planets to reach the No. 1 spot as the best cat planet. Reaching the top rewards you with the achievement: "Above Them All".



\[Cats]
Five new cats have been added, allowing players to earn the “The Completionist” achievement without using the Steam Market or buying cats:

Cookie (Uncommon)

Leo (Rare)

Bella (Rare)

Daisy (Rare)

Coco (Rare)



\[Changes & Improvements]

The cat planet invitation now appears as an envelope that you must open, instead of a basic pop-up. The invitation UI has been fully redesigned.

In Stage 2, Magic Cats and Giga Cats are now locked at the start. To unlock them, purchase a country (for Magic Cats) or a planet (for Giga Cats) in the Human Shop.

The drop rate for Legendary Cats has been increased from 0.00001% to 0.01%.

Lucky is no longer available in the Steam Shop.

A one-time popup now appears at the start of the game to explain basic controls.

For this week only, you have a 10% chance to drop the Epic Cat “Finn”.

A full 100% completion guide has been added, detailing how to unlock every achievement and collect all cats.

Buying True Cat God, Magic Cats, and Giga Cats now rewards ~2000 extra humans per run

Minor bug fixes and small Stage 1 balance adjustments.







\[A Note from the Developer – 1 Year of CAT 🐱🎉]
On July 19, 2024, CAT launched on Steam. It began as a small clicker game with around 8 cats, 6 upgrades, and 7 achievements (if I remember right). But that wasn’t enough for me.

I kept updating it—adding upgrades, balancing mechanics, improving the UI, implementing Steam Cloud, adding save systems, human mechanics, and of course... lots more cats.

Now, one year later, CAT has come a long way. The game is 100x better than it was at launch. This update brings in a story, new mechanics, and new cats—a final major update to celebrate everything we’ve built together.

To date, CAT has been picked up by nearly 100,000 players and received 192 reviews, with almost 75% positive. I’m incredibly grateful for your support, your feedback, and all the bug reports that helped make the game what it is today.

While this may be CAT’s final major update, I started a new project back in January—more news on that soon.

Thank you again for supporting CAT.
– Szanny 🐾💖

notes.title: Game Update 31(Adjustments, new way of getting cats, clarity)
notes.notes:
[Game Update 31]

[Changes & Improvements]
- You can now gain cats by clicking keyboard buttons, not just the mouse—click your way however you like!
- After purchasing the God Cat in Stage 1, your score will now display as "SCORE/100000000", making it clear to new players that 100 million cats are needed to reach Stage 2.
- The maximum clicks per second has been increased from 25 to 50, allowing for even faster progress.

[💬 Developer's Note]
Thanks so much for helping with bug reports and sharing ideas for new features. Cat has come a long way—it not only looks better but is far more fun to play than on release day. I hope we can keep improving it together.

In the upcoming Cats Update, likely arriving in a few months, I plan to introduce:
- A story for Stage 2
- New game mechanics
- More cats to collect

I truly hope you enjoy the current state of the game.
– Szanny 🐾💖

[Game Update 27]

Hey everyone, Szanny here! First of all, a huge THANK YOU for supporting Cat! 🥳
We've officially surpassed 50,000 copies obtained by players and hit 75% positive reviews on Steam! This is an incredible milestone, and I truly believe we can grow this project into something even bigger—maybe even reaching the legendary status of Cookie Clicker one day! Who knows what the future holds?

At the start of the secound stage, you’re now limited to 10,000 humans.
Humans now grants 1% bonus instead of 2%.

Upgrade UI Enhancement:

Hovering over an upgrade's cost button now shows how many purchases are needed for full max-upgrade!

Balance:

 Basic game upgrades now give you bigger bonuses so getting into secound stage of the game will be easier.


[New Upgrades]
New Human Upgrades:

2 Limit Extenders for scores 500B and 1T.
3 Human Limit Extenders to 50K, 100K, and 1M humans.

With this update, we’ve officially hit 2 major milestones from our 2025 roadmap! 🏁
There’s still one big update left, but don’t worry—the game will continue to receive smaller updates throughout the year. Stay tuned!

Thanks again for being part of this journey. Let's keep making Cat even bigger! 💖

notes.title: Game Update 26(Steam Could + Drop change)
notes.notes:
[Game Update 26]

[New Features]
Steam Cloud is now fully functional, meaning no more lost progress! However, there is a small chance that your save file might be reset. I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. If you experience this issue, you can manually restore your progress by editing the Scatdata.data file located in LocalLow/Shanny/Cat.

[Changes]
To make the drop system more intuitive, the first drop will now be granted immediately upon starting the game. Previously, some players were confused about not receiving a drop within the first few minutes of gameplay. Now, there’s no need to wait—your first drop appears right away, and the next ones will follow every 5 minutes(max 2 per 8h).

What’s Next?
This update marks the completion of the first of four planned updates for Cat in 2025. Three major updates are still on the way—stay tuned! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092241/ec060d8db2e6d52c5174b4d37e022ad641d2431c.png
